title: Lefroy Bay area, HiRISE DTM (every 5th post of the 1 m mosaic; bounded crop)

dtm.format: GeoTIFF, float32, uncompressed, 1 band, one row per strip (read with HTTP byte ranges)
dtm.crs: Equirectangular (standard parallel 0°, central meridian 0°), Mars 2000 sphere R = 3,396,190 m; planetocentric latitude, east-positive longitude
dtm.verticalDatum: Heights in metres relative to the Mars areoid (product label: MOLAtopography_DeltaGeoid)

crop.rationale: The area of the CTX crop (Lefroy Bay, the verified Margin sample sites and the scenario-defined targets A–C), snapped to the 1 m HiRISE grid; every 5th post (the centre post of each 5 × 5 block) is kept, unchanged, for a 5 m mesh.

heights.encoding: float32 little-endian, row-major from north to south, west to east; output post (k, j) is DTM post (col0 + 5k + 2, row0 + 5j + 2), copied unchanged; its value sits at the centre of its 5 m cell

imagery.resampling: bilinear from the z14 tile mosaic onto the crop's exact bounds; greyscale

versusCtxCrop.method: HiRISE (bilinear on the 5 m posts) minus the committed CTX crop, at every CTX post centre inside this crop

alignment.method: Topographic shading: normalised cross-correlation between the high-passed orthoimage brightness and the DTM slope along a fitted illumination azimuth, on a 20 m check grid (block means used only for this check), for shifts of ±4 cells. The build fails if the peak is more than 2 cells from zero.
alignment.interpretation: Rules out a gross offset (2 cells, 40 m, or more) between imagery and elevations. USGS states the orthomosaic is co-registered to the DTM within 3 m (99th percentile); this check does not demonstrate that.

caveats: The 1 m HiRISE DTM resolves relief of a few metres; the 5 m mesh shows every 5th post, so features smaller than about 10–20 m are not shown, and nothing here shows individual rocks or traversability.
Elevations are relative to the areoid, not to the surface of a reference ellipsoid.
The PDS sample-site elevations may themselves come from HiRISE-based localisation, so the close agreement is not a fully independent check.
The scenario-defined targets are simulated positions; their elevations are read from the DTM only to place them on the surface.
